text: Heeferɓe ɓe aaƴiima wonde ɓe ummintaake e genaale caggal ndeɓe maayi, maakan aan nelaaɗo ɓe yedduɓe: ma on ummine tigi refi kabreɗon ko gollaynaɗon e aduna, ngool ummingol na newanii Alla, ngam ko kanko tagnoo on ka adii, wadde hombo waawi on umminde caggal on maayi, O wuurtina on O yoɓa on caggal haasbeede.
